hook.say: Five countries where the capital is not the most famous city. Three seconds each. Can you get all five?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.fact: Queen Victoria picked Ottawa as the capital in 1857.
questions.sayAnswer: Ottawa! Queen Victoria picked it as the capital in 1857.

questions.q: What is the capital of Brazil?
questions.fact: Brasília was built from scratch and replaced Rio de Janeiro in 1960.
questions.sayAnswer: Brasilia! It was built from scratch, and replaced Rio de Janeiro as the capital in 1960.

questions.q: What is the capital of New Zealand?
questions.fact: Wellington is the southernmost capital of any sovereign country.
questions.sayAnswer: Wellington! It is the southernmost capital of any sovereign country in the world.

questions.q: What is the capital of Morocco?
questions.fact: Casablanca is Morocco's biggest city, but the government sits in Rabat.
questions.sayAnswer: Rabat! Casablanca is Morocco's biggest city, but the government sits in Rabat.

questions.q: What is the capital of Myanmar?
questions.fact: Myanmar moved its government from Yangon to brand-new Naypyidaw in 2005.
questions.sayAnswer: Nay-pee-daw! Myanmar moved its government there from Yangon in 2005, to a brand new city.
